assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The service provided is mobile cardiac telemetry.
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
There is concern for undiagnosed paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential embolic source.
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I48.91, and R00.2.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The study aims to guide anticoagulation therapy and rate control management based on the burden of atrial fibrillation detected.
